Package com.sca4d.core.api.setting

Class WritableSetting<T>

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.setting.Setting<T>
com.sca4d.core.api.setting.WritableSetting<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
PersonalSetting, SystemSetting
public class WritableSetting<T> extends Setting<T>
直接在明确目标中替换或清除当前 owner 的覆盖值，不修改继承 owner。
